notes.title: DECK COLLECTOR v0.2.1
notes.content: [h3][b]DECK COLLECTOR v0.2.1[/b][/h3][p]Collector Mode introduces a walkable 3D environment where you can place objects, unbox packs, unbox preconstructed decks of cards, go shopping, add cards to binders, check out each card in detail, add posters and canvas art, view your collection progress, and more![/p][p][/p][p][b]Object placement and editing tool:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571635/9233a8716ef2d884fd19e328d78a8f5870914b96.png"][/img][/p][p][b]View cards in detail:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571635/58cf214193026325ed95e6574a85a76498adafae.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Add Posters:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571635/24361629ada2b3ce458dfc5cb49bf6f66cb570e7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Ultra Realism![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571635/098957b0684509599319c2e7795f736201ff49b7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Place cards in 3D binders:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571635/98feeaad003e592439eacc67fc6172da674cd785.png"][/img][/p][p]This update is the initial milestone where the game comes to life! There are a massive amount of features in this update:[/p][list][*][p]Build your collection by placing cards in 3D binders with a FIRST OF ITS KIND page-offset for ultra realism[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple sets, packs, and decks of cards to open[/p][/*][*][p]View each card in stunning detail with ultra realistic holographic foils[/p][/*][*][p]User controllability through the settings page[/p][/*][*][p]All settings files are in plain text format for easy editing[/p][/*][*][p]Realistic graphics using PBR[/p][/*][*][p]Import your own Rooms and Objects to play in game![/p][/*][*][p]View your progress of each set and deck[/p][/*][*][p]Cinematic camera with THOUSANDS of combinations for cinematic video[/p][/*][*][p]Pick your color to colorize your game![/p][/*][*][p]Changeable images for some backgrounds[/p][/*][*][p]3D posters and canvas art where you can use your own photos[/p][/*][*][p]Image and text import style mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Control the look of the game with camera settings (color adjustments, bloom, depth of field, vignette, etc…)[/p][/*][*][p]Import textures for Lens Dirt and Overlays[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-focus depth of field[/p][/*][*][p]Free-play style gameplay, open as many packs as you want![/p][/*][*][p]Go to the store to buy objects, products, furniture, binders, trading cards, lights, TVs, and more![/p][/*][*][p]Jump in now to crack open some packs![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571635/f6976dc52ab2893c631fb237b6ad3f46e6808068.gif"][/img][/p]
